searchText: For the uTP protocol, I think the thing we need to try and measure or calculate is: 1) bandwidth overhead and 2) overall throughput. Ideally we could compare these to libp2p as our baseline. 1M is a pretty big/optimistic number I feel like, but perhaps I'm just a pessimist. Is there a canonical source that references the latest information/research on historical state retrieval ? <@!476250636548308992> can you define "historical state retrieval" a bit more, not clear what you mean. (Here is a glossary of terminology if it helps: https://github.com/ethereum/stateless-ethereum-specs/wiki/Glossary) Ah in terms of the glossary it would be Chain History Ah k thanks, I think that repo was what i was looking for
